before: A document that omitted its default run or paragraph properties laid out at 10pt with no spacing, and paste, copy, and the formatting readers used the same values.
after: Omitted defaults resolve to 12pt text with 8pt after and 278/240 automatic line spacing. Paste stamps these values when the target defaults differ.
reason: The defaults are derived from the shared styles part and are not stored. Paste stamps ordinary run and paragraph properties through the existing fragment operations, which released participants apply unchanged.
